senses.en: To make an achievement, position, or skill stronger.
To combine separate things into a single effective whole.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to consolidate knowledge.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须巩固知识。

ex.en: The passage says students who can consolidate knowledge follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够巩固知识的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 既可指巩固已有成果，也可指合并多个部分。

senses.en: Animal waste used to improve soil and help plants grow.
To spread animal waste on land as fertilizer.

ex.en: Office hours began with animal manure.
ex.zh: 答疑从动物粪肥开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of animal manure.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得动物粪肥这个例子。

tip: 名词通常不可数；fertilizer泛指肥料，范围更广。

senses.en: Best or most effective for a particular purpose.

ex.en: I copied optimal conditions into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把最佳条件抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of optimal conditions.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得最佳条件这个例子。

tip: 已含“最佳”之意，通常不再用 most 修饰。

senses.en: In a determined way, without giving up or changing course

ex.en: The professor told us to resolutely oppose and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们坚决反对，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will resolutely oppose when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会坚决反对。

tip: 这是副词；形容词形式为resolute。

senses.en: to keep returning to someone's mind and causing distress
for a ghost to appear repeatedly in a place
a place someone visits frequently

ex.en: I heard the lecturer haunt an old house during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时在老房子里出没。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers haunt an old house before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要在老房子里出没。

col: be haunted by memories｜被回忆困扰
haunt an old house｜在老房子里出没
a favourite haunt｜最爱常去的地方
tip: 作动词直接接宾语；be haunted by表示受困扰。

senses.en: to have particular people or things as parts
to be the parts or members that form something

ex.en: I heard the lecturer comprise several sections during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时包含几个部分。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to comprise several sections.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们包含几个部分。

col: comprise several sections｜包含几个部分
comprise a range of services｜涵盖一系列服务
tip: 最稳妥结构：整体comprises部分，不加of。

senses.en: people who belong to a royal family
a payment for using someone's work, invention, or property

ex.en: I copied a member of royalty into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把王室成员抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a member of royalty.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得王室成员这个例子。

col: a member of royalty｜王室成员
tip: 指王族时不可数；指版税收入时常用复数royalties。

senses.en: To die or be destroyed, especially in harsh conditions.
To decay or lose strength and flexibility over time.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to perish from cold.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须冻死。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers perish from cold before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要冻死。

col: perish in a fire｜在火灾中丧生
tip: 通常是不及物动词；英式英语也用于橡胶等老化。

senses.en: able to be moved or passed to another person or place
useful in different jobs or situations

ex.en: Our professor circled transferable skills on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可迁移技能。

ex.en: The author returns to transferable skills when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了可迁移技能。

tip: transferable skills 指换岗位或行业仍适用的技能。

senses.en: a bad habit or morally wrong behaviour
a tool that holds an object firmly between two jaws

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a minor vice.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小恶习。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a minor vice.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得小恶习这个例子。

tip: 台钳在美式英语中拼作vise；副主席中的vice-是前缀。

senses.en: a passage through which air reaches the lungs
an established route used by aircraft

ex.en: I copied upper airway into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把上呼吸道抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used upper airway to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用上呼吸道来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: keep the airway clear｜保持气道通畅
tip: 常指呼吸道；航线义较专业，勿与airline混淆。

senses.en: to force someone to do something

ex.en: The lab instructions say to compel someone to act.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求迫使某人行动。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to compel someone to act.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们迫使某人行动。

col: compel someone to act｜迫使某人行动
be compelled by circumstances｜为形势所迫
tip: 常用compel sb to do，语气强且较正式。

senses.en: Force people to leave their homes or usual surroundings.
Take the position or role previously held by something else.
Move something from its position, especially by occupying its space.

ex.en: The assignment is to displace workers, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先取代工人，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to displace workers.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得取代工人。

tip: displace常指被迫迁离；也可指新事物取代旧事物。

senses.en: To attract someone by offering something appealing, sometimes deceptively.
An attraction or object used to draw someone or something closer.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to lure customers.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求吸引顾客。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to lure customers.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得吸引顾客。

col: lure someone into doing something｜诱使某人做某事
the lure of wealth｜财富的诱惑
tip: 常用lure sb into doing，往往暗含诱骗意味。

senses.en: An officer holding a junior rank in the armed forces
A trusted assistant who helps a leader manage important work

ex.en: Our professor circled army lieutenant on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了陆军中尉。

ex.en: A campus survey used army lieutenant to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用陆军中尉来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 英式开头读/lef/，美式读/luː/；军衔译名因军种而异。

senses.en: The gradual gathering of something, or the amount gathered.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on gradual accumulation.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论逐渐积累。

ex.en: The reading connects gradual accumulation with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把逐渐积累和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常接of，强调随时间逐渐增多。

senses.en: a statement about the future, often claiming supernatural knowledge
the supposed ability to know and describe future events

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a self-fulfilling prophecy.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论自我实现的预言。

ex.en: The reading connects a self-fulfilling prophecy with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把自我实现的预言和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a self-fulfilling prophecy｜自我实现的预言
the gift of prophecy｜预言天赋
tip: prophecy是名词；动词prophesy词尾读/saɪ/。

senses.en: A belief or set of principles taught by a group.

ex.en: Office hours began with religious doctrine.
ex.zh: 答疑从宗教教义开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around religious doctrine.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕宗教教义展开说明。

tip: 不一定含贬义；可指宗教教义或政治、经济学说。

senses.en: calm and peaceful, without noise or disturbance

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a tranquil setting.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于宁静的环境的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a tranquil setting to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用宁静的环境来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 常描写环境或水面，比 quiet 更强调安宁感。

senses.en: To grow strongly or become successful.

ex.en: The professor asked us to thrive in warm conditions.
ex.zh: 教授让我们在温暖环境中茁壮成长。

ex.en: The reading asks you to thrive in warm conditions and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你在温暖环境中茁壮成长，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: thrive in warm conditions｜在温暖环境中茁壮成长
thrive on challenges｜遇到挑战更有干劲
a thriving business｜生意兴隆的企业
tip: 不及物动词；thrive on表示因某事而更有活力。

senses.en: Something that encourages activity, growth, or change.
Something that causes a physical or mental response.

ex.en: I copied economic stimulus into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把经济刺激抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss economic stimulus.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济刺激的材料。

col: a stimulus to growth｜促进增长的因素
respond to a stimulus｜对刺激作出反应
tip: 复数是stimuli；stimulus to中的to是介词。

senses.en: Easily upset or offended, especially by criticism.
Likely to cause upset or disagreement unless handled carefully.

ex.en: Office hours began with touchy about criticism.
ex.zh: 答疑从对批评很敏感开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used touchy about criticism to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用对批评很敏感来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: touchy about criticism｜对批评很敏感
a touchy issue｜棘手的敏感问题
tip: touchy指易生气；touched指受感动。

senses.en: The skill and quality shown in making something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fine workmanship.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论精细的做工。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fine workmanship.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕精细的做工展开说明。

tip: 不可数名词，强调成品的做工，而非工作态度。

senses.en: to gather and arrange people, resources, or ideas effectively
someone who directs people and maintains order at an event
a military officer holding a very high rank

ex.en: The assignment is to marshal resources, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先调集资源，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to marshal resources and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你调集资源，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 英式过去式marshalled，美式marshaled；勿混淆martial。

senses.en: relating to medicines or their production
a drug used as medicine

ex.en: The textbook introduces pharmaceutical industry in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了制药业。

ex.en: The author returns to pharmaceutical industry when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了制药业。

tip: 作名词常用复数 pharmaceuticals，泛指药品。

senses.en: offering little hope of improvement or success
cold, bare, and unwelcoming

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on bleak future.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论黯淡的未来。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss bleak future.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论黯淡的未来的材料。

tip: 既可描述荒凉阴冷的环境，也可描述无望的前景。

senses.en: Very tired, especially after prolonged effort
No longer interested in something because it continues too long
To make someone tired or become tired of something

ex.en: The textbook introduces grow weary in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了渐感疲倦。

ex.en: A campus survey used grow weary to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用渐感疲倦来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

tip: weary是疲倦的；wary是警惕的，注意拼写。

senses.en: A layer that covers a surface or area
The thick layer of Earth between its crust and core
An important role or responsibility passed to someone

ex.en: The textbook introduces Earth's mantle in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了地幔。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around Earth's mantle.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕地幔展开说明。

col: a mantle of snow｜一层积雪
assume the mantle of｜承担……的职责
tip: mantle也可指披风；壁炉架通常拼作mantel。

senses.en: used in or connected with a formal public ceremony

ex.en: Office hours began with ceremonial dress.
ex.zh: 答疑从礼仪服饰开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of ceremonial dress.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得礼仪服饰这个例子。

tip: ceremonial重在仪式用途；ceremonious指礼节隆重。

senses.en: Relating to the moon.
Based on the changing phases of the moon.

ex.en: The textbook introduces lunar eclipse in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了月食。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of lunar eclipse.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得月食这个例子。

tip: lunar指月亮的；solar指太阳的。

senses.en: to manage an organization or put a system into operation
to give someone medicine or medical treatment

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to administer a programme.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何管理项目。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to administer a programme.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得管理项目。

tip: 给某人用药可说administer medicine to someone。

senses.en: The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.

ex.en: The textbook introduces fuel combustion in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了燃料燃烧。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fuel combustion.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论燃料燃烧的材料。

tip: 通常不可数，是burning的科技语体表达。

senses.en: Having no name, or having a name that remains unknown
Too difficult to identify or describe clearly

ex.en: Our professor circled nameless fear on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了莫名的恐惧。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of nameless fear.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得莫名的恐惧这个例子。

tip: remain nameless指不透露姓名，不一定真的没名字。

senses.en: an event causing extremely serious damage or suffering

ex.en: Our professor circled environmental catastrophe on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了环境灾难。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of environmental catastrophe.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得环境灾难这个例子。

col: avert a catastrophe｜避免一场灾难
tip: 比一般problem严重，常指损失惨重的灾难。

senses.en: a ring of flowers or leaves used decoratively or ceremonially

ex.en: The textbook introduces laurel wreath in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了月桂花冠。

ex.en: The author returns to laurel wreath when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了月桂花冠。

col: a wreath of flowers｜鲜花编成的花环
tip: w不发音；复数wreaths；动词另用wreathe。

senses.en: Clear enough for written or printed words to be read.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about clearly legible.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于清晰可辨的的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used clearly legible to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用清晰可辨的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: legible强调字形可辨；readable也可指内容易读。

senses.en: kind and polite, especially when treating others generously
elegant, comfortable, and associated with wealth

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a gracious host.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论热情有礼的主人。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a gracious host.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得热情有礼的主人这个例子。

col: a gracious host｜热情有礼的主人
gracious in defeat｜落败仍有风度
tip: gracious重待人有礼；graceful重动作优美。

senses.en: A person who works on a ship at sea.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an experienced seaman.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经验丰富的海员。

ex.en: The author returns to an experienced seaman when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经验丰富的海员。

col: an experienced seaman｜经验丰富的海员
tip: 复数为seamen；seafarer是常用的性别中性称呼。

senses.en: requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work

ex.en: The textbook introduces an arduous task in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了艰巨的任务。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an arduous task.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论艰巨的任务的材料。

tip: 强调长期费力，常修饰task、journey、process。

senses.en: in a clear and direct way that leaves no doubt
for a particular purpose

ex.en: The professor told us to expressly prohibit and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们明令禁止，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: A lecture on public institutions asks the class to expressly prohibit before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于公共制度的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先明令禁止。

tip: 勿与expressively混淆，后者指富有表现力地。

senses.en: an idea accepted as true without enough evidence

ex.en: The textbook introduces mere supposition in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纯属推测。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mere supposition.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论纯属推测的材料。

tip: 可指一个假设，也可泛指推测；不等于已证实的事实。

senses.en: Relating to heat
Designed to keep heat from escaping
A rising current of warm air

ex.en: I copied thermal energy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把热能抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of thermal energy.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得热能这个例子。

tip: thermal可指与热有关，也可指衣物保暖。

senses.en: To recognize or explain the differences between things
To make something different from other similar things

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to differentiate between.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何区分两者。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to differentiate between.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们区分两者。

col: differentiate A from B｜区分甲与乙
tip: 常用differentiate between A and B。

senses.en: To decorate cloth by sewing patterns with thread.
To make a story more interesting by adding invented details.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer embroider a pattern during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时绣图案。

ex.en: When the class discussed the humanities, the speaker told us to embroider a pattern.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人文学科时，讲者让我们绣图案。

col: embroider flowers on cloth｜在布上绣花
embroider with silk thread｜用丝线刺绣
embroider a story｜给故事添油加醋
tip: embroider是在布上绣花，不是用毛线织物的knit。

senses.en: A decorative picture made by cutting shapes from paper

ex.en: Office hours began with a traditional papercut.
ex.zh: 答疑从传统剪纸作品开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used a traditional papercut to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用传统剪纸作品来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

col: a traditional papercut｜传统剪纸作品
an intricate papercut｜精细的剪纸作品
tip: 剪纸艺术常用papercutting；纸划伤通常写paper cut。

senses.en: Consisting of parts or people that are all similar

ex.en: Office hours began with relatively homogeneous.
ex.zh: 答疑从相对同质的开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around relatively homogeneous.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕相对同质的展开说明。

tip: 强调组成部分相似或一致，反义词为heterogeneous。

senses.en: Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong
The degree to which an action is right or wrong

ex.en: The textbook introduces public morality in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了社会公德。

ex.en: The reading connects public morality with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把社会公德和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the morality of an action｜某一行为的道德性
tip: moral是形容词；morality是名词，常为不可数。

senses.en: General agreement among members of a group.

ex.en: The textbook introduces broad consensus in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了广泛共识。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of broad consensus.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得广泛共识这个例子。

tip: 常用reach a consensus on；共识未必全票一致。

senses.en: A woman having a relationship with someone married to another person.
A woman who owns or controls a household, in older usage.
A woman highly skilled in a particular activity.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used mistress in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了情妇。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses mistress when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了情妇。

col: mistress of the house｜一家之女主人
mistress of her craft｜精通技艺的女性
tip: 不可当作妻子或普通女友；女主人义较陈旧。

senses.en: A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.

ex.en: I copied ammonia solution into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把氨水抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss ammonia solution.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论氨水的材料。

tip: 不可数名词；既可指氨气，也可指氨水。

senses.en: Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.

ex.en: The textbook introduces political allegiance in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了政治上的效忠。

ex.en: A campus survey used political allegiance to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用政治上的效忠来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 效忠对象用to引出：allegiance to a country。

senses.en: extreme tiredness caused by effort, stress, or illness
weakening of a material after repeated stress

ex.en: Office hours began with chronic fatigue.
ex.zh: 答疑从慢性疲劳开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss chronic fatigue.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论慢性疲劳的材料。

tip: 通常为不可数名词，比tiredness更正式。

senses.en: Giving information that makes something easier to understand.

ex.en: Office hours began with explanatory notes.
ex.zh: 答疑从说明性注释开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around explanatory notes.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕说明性注释展开说明。

tip: 常修饰notes、material；self-explanatory指不言自明的。

senses.en: to begin something or start happening

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to commence work.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何开始工作。

ex.en: The passage says students who can commence work follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够开始工作的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 比start正式；可接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance.
The skill or study of using language to persuade.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about empty rhetoric.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于空洞的言辞的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used empty rhetoric to explain a pattern in public communication.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用空洞的言辞来解释公共传播中的一种模式。

col: the art of rhetoric｜修辞艺术
tip: 是名词；形容词为rhetorical，可含贬义。

senses.en: A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.

ex.en: The professor explained pretext with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了借口。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses pretext when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了借口。

col: under the pretext of｜以……为借口
a pretext for doing something｜做某事的借口
tip: 强调掩盖真实目的的借口；常接for或of。

senses.en: To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it.
To seize an opportunity or criticise a mistake immediately.
A sudden jump towards something to catch or attack it.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to pounce on prey.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须猛扑向猎物。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to pounce on prey.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来猛扑向猎物。

col: pounce on an opportunity｜立即抓住机会
pounce on a mistake｜揪住错误不放
tip: 常接on，既可指猛扑，也可指抓住机会或错误。

senses.en: Introducing important new ideas or methods before others.

ex.en: Office hours began with pioneering research.
ex.zh: 答疑从开创性研究开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of pioneering research.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得开创性研究这个例子。

tip: 通常作形容词；指先驱人物用名词pioneer。

senses.en: A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort.
A formal promise to do something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a major undertaking.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论重大任务。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a major undertaking.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕重大任务展开说明。

col: a joint undertaking｜共同承担的项目
give an undertaking｜作出正式承诺
tip: 作“承诺”时常用give an undertaking to do。

senses.en: to stop something from having an effect
to make an acid or alkali chemically neutral

ex.en: The assignment is to neutralize an acid, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先中和酸，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to neutralize an acid.
ex.zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们中和酸。

tip: 英式也拼neutralise；强调抵消作用，不一定移除物体。

senses.en: A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.
A breath of air released when pronouncing certain speech sounds.

ex.en: Office hours began with aspiration to succeed.
ex.zh: 答疑从成功的志向开始。

ex.en: The reading connects aspiration to succeed with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把成功的志向和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 抱负义常用复数；aspiration to do表示做某事的志向。

senses.en: an idea or understanding of what something is like
the process in which an egg is fertilised, beginning pregnancy
the formation of a plan or idea

ex.en: I copied a broad conception into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把宽泛的理解抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a broad conception.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕宽泛的理解展开说明。

col: from conception to completion｜从构思到完成
the moment of conception｜受孕时刻
tip: conception of指对事物的理解；也可表示受孕。

senses.en: With care and a strong sense of responsibility.

ex.en: The professor told us to conscientiously carry out duties and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们认真履行职责，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy asks the class to conscientiously carry out duties before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先认真履行职责。

col: conscientiously carry out duties｜认真履行职责
tip: 强调责任心与认真态度，不只是动作小心。

senses.en: A subgroup whose views conflict with others in a larger group.

ex.en: Our professor circled political faction on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了政治派别。

ex.en: The author returns to political faction when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了政治派别。

col: a faction within the party｜党内派系
tip: 常指大组织内意见对立的小集团，尤用于政治。

senses.en: Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region
Relating to Australia's Aboriginal peoples, cultures, or languages

ex.en: Office hours began with aboriginal peoples.
ex.zh: 答疑从原住民族开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of aboriginal peoples.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得原住民族这个例子。

col: Aboriginal culture｜澳大利亚原住民文化
Aboriginal communities｜澳大利亚原住民社区
tip: 指澳大利亚原住民时首字母大写；避免单独作名词称人。

senses.en: to balance or reduce the effect of something

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to offset the cost.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须抵消成本。

ex.en: The reading asks you to offset the cost and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你抵消成本，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 过去式和过去分词仍为offset；现在分词为offsetting。

senses.en: Suitable for or used for growing crops.

ex.en: I copied arable land into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把耕地抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around arable land.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕耕地展开说明。

tip: 常修饰land；强调可种作物，不指单纯放牧用地。

senses.en: An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a temporary truce.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论临时停战。

ex.en: A campus survey used a temporary truce to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用临时停战来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: agree to a truce｜同意停战
break a truce｜破坏休战协议
tip: 通常指暂时停止冲突，不等于永久和平。

senses.zh: 兴高采烈的；热情洋溢的
senses.en: full of energy, excitement, and happiness
growing abundantly or richly decorated and imaginative

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on exuberant enthusiasm.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高涨的热情。

ex.en: The reading connects exuberant enthusiasm with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把高涨的热情和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an exuberant personality｜热情奔放的性格
tip: 核心是活力或丰富程度高，不等于“华而不实”。

senses.en: A compound consisting of oxygen and another chemical element.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on zinc oxide.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论氧化锌。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of zinc oxide.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得氧化锌这个例子。

tip: oxide为氧化物统称，dioxide指二氧化物。

senses.en: write or carve words on an object, often permanently

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to inscribe a name on.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须把名字刻在……上。

ex.en: A lecture on the humanities showed why researchers inscribe a name on before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人文学科的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要把名字刻在……上。

col: inscribe a name on｜把名字刻在……上
tip: 常用inscribe A on B或inscribe B with A，非普通记笔记。

senses.en: A broad statement based on particular cases, sometimes without enough evidence.
The process of forming general conclusions from particular examples.

ex.en: The textbook introduces sweeping generalization in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了过于笼统的论断。

ex.en: The author returns to sweeping generalization when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了过于笼统的论断。

tip: 英式也写 generalisation；概括未必可靠。

senses.en: To move an organ or plant into a new location.
An operation transferring an organ, or the organ transferred.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to transplant seedlings.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求移栽幼苗。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to transplant seedlings.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得移栽幼苗。

tip: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；既可指器官也可指植物。

senses.en: To support and maintain a principle, right, or standard
To confirm that an earlier decision remains valid

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to uphold the law.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何维护法律。

ex.en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to uphold the law.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们维护法律。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为upheld；常接权利或裁决。

senses.en: Behaviour that follows accepted rules, standards, or group expectations.

ex.en: Our professor circled social conformity on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会从众。

ex.en: The author returns to social conformity when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了社会从众。

col: pressure for conformity｜要求一致的压力
tip: in conformity with表示符合或遵照某规则。

senses.en: A required procedure, often unlikely to change the outcome.
The quality of following official rules or social conventions.

ex.en: Our professor circled a mere formality on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了纯粹的例行手续。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a mere formality.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕纯粹的例行手续展开说明。

col: a mere formality｜纯粹的例行手续
tip: 手续常用复数formalities；正式、拘谨为不可数义。

senses.en: boring because it continues too long or involves repeated actions

ex.en: Office hours began with tedious task.
ex.zh: 答疑从乏味的任务开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of tedious task.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得乏味的任务这个例子。

tip: 常形容因耗时长或反复重复而乏味的任务。

senses.en: Money spent on a particular purpose, especially when starting something.

ex.en: I copied initial outlay into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把初期支出抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss initial outlay.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论初期支出的材料。

tip: 常指启动项目时的开支，常搭配initial或capital。

senses.en: Having sharp corners or clearly defined angles.
Thin, with bones and joints that appear prominent.

ex.en: I copied angular shape into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把有棱角的形状抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects angular shape with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把有棱角的形状和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 形容外形棱角分明，也可形容人瘦削。

senses.en: To replace goods that have been sold or used.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to restock shelves.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须补充货架商品。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to restock shelves.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们补充货架商品。

col: restock the fridge｜补充冰箱食品
restock with fresh supplies｜补充新物资
tip: 常用restock A with B，表示用B补充A的存货。

senses.en: A bitter disagreement continuing for a long time.
To remain in a bitter, continuing conflict with someone.

ex.en: I copied family feud into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把家族纷争抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used family feud to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用家族纷争来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: feud with someone｜与某人长期不和
tip: 强调持续很久的敌对或争执，而非一次口角。

senses.en: A drink believed to have magical or medicinal effects.

ex.en: Office hours began with a magic potion.
ex.zh: 答疑从魔法药水开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a magic potion with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把魔法药水和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常见于奇幻故事；普通药物的一剂用dose。

senses.en: to judge the quality, condition, or performance of something
to estimate how much money something is worth

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to appraise performance.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须评估表现。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to appraise performance.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来评估表现。

col: appraise a property｜评估房产价值
tip: appraise是评估；不要与apprise（告知）混淆。

senses.en: a tax charged on goods entering or leaving a country
a set of charges for a service

ex.en: Office hours began with import tariff.
ex.zh: 答疑从进口关税开始。

ex.en: The reading connects import tariff with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把进口关税和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 关税用tariff on goods；复数tariffs常指多项关税。

senses.en: using mocking words, often meaning the opposite, to criticize

ex.en: Our professor circled a sarcastic remark on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了挖苦的话。

ex.en: The author returns to a sarcastic remark when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了挖苦的话。

tip: 常用反话挖苦人；ironic不一定含攻击或嘲弄。

senses.en: Causing extremely serious damage or destruction.
Causing overwhelming sadness or emotional shock.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on devastating consequences.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论灾难性后果。

ex.en: A campus survey used devastating consequences to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用灾难性后果来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

col: devastating news｜令人悲痛欲绝的消息
devastating earthquake｜破坏力极强的地震
tip: 事物令人悲痛用devastating；人感到悲痛用devastated。

senses.en: Empty of people and lacking signs of life
Feeling completely alone and deeply unhappy

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a desolate landscape.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论荒凉的景观。

ex.en: The author returns to a desolate landscape when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了荒凉的景观。

col: a desolate village｜荒无人烟的村庄
tip: 形容地方指荒凉，形容人则指孤独凄凉。

senses.en: a mammal with strong front teeth that grow continuously

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about rodent population.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于啮齿动物种群的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of rodent population.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得啮齿动物种群这个例子。

tip: 老鼠、松鼠和河狸都属啮齿动物。

senses.en: The process of making conditions normal or usual.
Adjusting data or values to a common standard.

ex.en: I copied data normalization into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把数据归一化抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss data normalization.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论数据归一化的材料。

tip: 英式也拼normalisation；数据语境常指归一化。

senses.en: Without achieving the desired result despite effort

ex.en: After the lecture, we used vainly in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了徒劳地。

ex.en: A reading on academic research uses vainly when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了徒劳地。

col: try vainly to do something｜徒劳地试图做某事
tip: vainly侧重努力无果，常可换成in vain。

senses.en: To surgically remove all or part of a limb.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer amputate a limb during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时截肢。

ex.en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers amputate a limb before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要截肢。

col: amputate below the knee｜进行膝下截肢
tip: 主要用于手术切除肢体，不能泛指切除所有器官。

senses.en: possible and practical to achieve with available resources

ex.en: I copied economically feasible into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把经济上可行的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss economically feasible.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济上可行的的材料。

col: a feasible solution｜可行的解决办法
a feasible alternative｜可行的替代方案
tip: 指条件允许、实际可行，不等于“可信”。

senses.en: a large structure or machine used for drilling
to dishonestly arrange a process to obtain a desired result
to fit equipment into place for use

ex.en: Our professor circled an oil rig on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了石油钻井平台。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an oil rig.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕石油钻井平台展开说明。

col: an oil rig｜石油钻井平台
rig up equipment｜临时搭建设备
tip: rig作动词既可指装配，也可指作弊操纵；注意语境。

senses.en: The gradual removal of soil or rock by natural forces.
The gradual loss of strength, value, or confidence.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on soil erosion.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论土壤侵蚀。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得土壤侵蚀这个例子。

col: erosion of trust｜信任的逐渐削弱
tip: 通常不可数；也可比喻信任、权利等逐渐受损。

senses.en: showing that you think someone or something deserves no respect

ex.en: The textbook introduces a scornful look in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了轻蔑的眼神。

ex.en: The author returns to a scornful look when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了轻蔑的眼神。

col: scornful of advice｜对建议不屑一顾
tip: 常用 scornful of，表示对某人或某事不屑。

senses.en: Making success harder or putting someone in a worse position.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about disadvantageous position.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于不利地位的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to disadvantageous position when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不利地位。

tip: 常用disadvantageous to sb表示对某人不利。

senses.en: To show something proudly to attract attention or admiration.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer flaunt wealth during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时炫耀财富。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to flaunt wealth.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们炫耀财富。

tip: flaunt指炫耀；flout指公然无视规则，勿混。

senses.en: strong, healthy, and unlikely to break or become weak
effective and reliable even under difficult conditions

ex.en: Office hours began with robust health.
ex.zh: 答疑从强健的体魄开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used robust health to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用强健的体魄来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 既形容身体或物品结实，也形容证据、系统可靠。

senses.en: Understood or accepted without being directly stated.

ex.en: Our professor circled tacit approval on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了默许。

ex.en: The author returns to tacit approval when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了默许。

tip: tacit指未明说但已理解，并非明确表达的同意。

senses.en: To become solid, or make something become solid.
To make an agreement, relationship, or position stronger and more secure.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to solidify into a mass.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求凝固成块。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers solidify into a mass before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要凝固成块。

col: solidify into a mass｜凝固成块
tip: 既可指液体凝固，也可指关系或地位得到巩固。
